description: Default invocation, no context. Captured from a live FlowAI run against the real sandbox (4 devices: sw1-sw4, Catalyst 9000 C9KV-UADP-8P, IOS-XE 17.12.1prd9) — the only compliance state currently reproducible in this environment (0 hard non-compliant, EoX warnings only, nothing remediable). No config-drift fixture is available yet to exercise the propose/approve/remediate branch — see the caveat in ../../itential/agent.spec.md Section 5.

observed_tool_calls.result_summary: all 4 devices COMPLIANT_WARNING (EOX/software), COMPLIANT (RUNNING_CONFIG, PSIRT), NOT_APPLICABLE (IMAGE, NETWORK_SETTINGS)
EOX SOFTWARE warning, remediationSupported: false, for all 4

expected_output_shape.discovery_line: States a real count (e.g. "0 of 4 devices non-compliant") plus the EoX warnings found even though they're not hard non-compliant
expected_output_shape.proposal_section: Omitted or explicitly states no automated remediation applies, because the only finding (EoX) is outside api_complianceRemediation's scope
expected_output_shape.approval_question: Not asked — nothing eligible was found to propose

assertions: Never calls api_complianceRemediation when nothing eligible was found
States the EoX findings as real findings, not silence, even though they're not the compliance type this agent can fix
Explicitly explains why EoX isn't remediable via this tool, rather than staying silent about it or fabricating a proposal
Does not claim the network is empty or fully clean beyond what the compliance tools actually returned
